ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white/light) localized pixel clusters resulting in an approximate 15:1 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across the macro-surface; localized high-contrast irregular blobs (white/light grey) clustered at the distal tips of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 5 to 15 pixels, appearing most jagged at the lateral extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex curve towards the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips; isolated circular light-grey spots (~10-20 pixels diameter) visible on the mid-surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions of higher intensity relative to the background visible on the central-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization forming dense, high-contrast raised clusters at the terminal ends of both lobes.
